dialogues.text: Thank you for the pitch. Before we go deeper, what is the single biggest pain point your product solves first?
Give us one concrete customer example so we understand who feels this problem the most.
And why now? Tell us what changed in the market that makes this the right timing.
Good. Now talk us through revenue. How exactly do you make money in the first 12 months?
How do you defend this from copycats once bigger players notice traction?
Last one from me: what milestone will prove this is venture-scale within six months?
